selection_rule: First50 of shared52 in canonical dataset order; no answers or scores used

source_scope.construction_time: Method wall time to build memory; full-context is zero.
source_scope.query_latency: End-to-end QA wall time when directly recorded. LightMem uses the file boundary immediately before QA.
source_scope.physical_tokens: All reported canonical LLM attempts, including retries; missing-usage calls are counted separately.
source_scope.final_tokens: Tokens from the retained final answer call when directly available.
source_scope.embedding_tokens: SDK receipts and server journals are reported separately because they have no shared request identifier; do not add them together.
source_scope.queueing: Wall-time fields may include shared GPU queue waiting; request journals preserve per-call time separately.

final_answer_call.availability_basis: Direct retained final-call usage in source aggregator

limitations: All 50 are single-session-user questions, not a representative full-500 population.
Construction and QA means are historical measured wall times for the same selected IDs; shared-GPU queue waiting and original execution hardware differences can be included.
LightMem query latency uses prediction mtime minus construction.json mtime; it is a proxy rather than a direct QA timer.
Physical LLM tokens include reported canonical attempts and retries. Any missing-usage calls make reported token totals a lower bound.
physical_failed_calls preserves the source column and must not be equated to distinct GPU crashes.
SimpleMem and LightMem retained final-call tokens are unavailable; source CSV initialization zeros are rendered as null rather than zero consumption.
These LLM token totals exclude embedding usage and the new semantic judge API calls.
